description: This file contains unit tests for the Github OAuth2 Provider implementation within the League OAuth2 Client library. It uses PHPUnit and Mockery to test various functionalities such as authorization URL generation, token retrieval, handling of enterprise domains, user data retrieval, and error scenarios.

classes.name: GithubTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the Github OAuth2 Provider implementation in the League OAuth2 client.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the Github provider instance with mock client credentials before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up Mockery mocks after each test.

methods.name: testAuthorizationUrl
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of the generated authorization URL and its query parameters.

methods.name: testScopes
methods.description: Checks that scope options are correctly included in the authorization URL.

methods.name: testGetAuthorizationUrl
methods.description: Ensures the base authorization URL path is correct.

methods.name: testGetBaseAccessTokenUrl
methods.description: Checks that the base access token URL path is correct.

methods.name: testGetAccessToken
methods.description: Mocks the HTTP response to test the extraction of the access token from the OAuth2 token endpoint.

methods.name: testGithubEnterpriseDomainUrls
methods.description: Tests URL generation when a custom GitHub enterprise domain is set, ensuring correct API paths.

methods.name: testUserData
methods.description: Mocks responses to test fetching and parsing of user profile data with JWT token exchange.

methods.name: testUserEmails
methods.description: Contains commented-out code intended for testing user email retrieval; currently inactive.

methods.name: testExceptionThrownWhenErrorObjectReceived
methods.description: Simulates an error response to verify that an exception is properly thrown when OAuth provider returns error object.

methods.name: testExceptionThrownWhenOAuthErrorReceived
methods.description: Simulates an OAuth error response to verify that an exception is thrown for OAuth errors.
